notes:
Account profile: Skyhook builds an IDE-focused copilots product for large internal engineering orgs. They need deterministic, reproducible code completions across developer workspaces and CI test runs. Main ask: model/version pinning with canary rollouts + automated eval gates so new model variants never regress key metrics.

Key technical requirements (summary):
- Model pinning per-repo and per-team (ability to pin minor versions, quantized variants).
- Canary traffic splitting: route 1-5% of users/requests to candidate model, ramp to 25% then 100% with automated rollback.
- Eval gates integrated into rollout: run predefined eval suites (compilation rate, edit-distance-to-reference, unit-test pass rate) and block promotion on regressions.
- Deterministic completions for snapshot tests: seed controls, reproducible KV cache behavior, and stable sampling for CI.
- Low-latency streaming target: <=30ms token latency for inline completions in the IDE, P99 tail <120ms.
- Support for pinned quantized variants (4-bit/8-bit) and stable semantic versioning semantics.
- Visibility: per-model per-route metrics (compile/success rate, revert events, token cost), audit logs for model changes, and developer-facing rollback commands.

- 2025-12-05: Intro call (drive deck shared). Action: send sample eval set.

- Week 1: baseline metrics collection (current completions, compile rate).
- Week 2-3: deploy candidate model behind canary, run eval suite nightly.
- Week 4: expand canary to 25% if no regressions.
- Week 5-7: stability & cost tuning (quantization + batching).
- Week 8: decision gate for Dedicated purchase or move to Private.
